project.name: Provenance
project.tagline: Royalties enforced by Move resources, not marketplace policy.
project.description: Provenance is a Move-based MiniMove appchain on Initia where digital artworks are first-class Object<Artwork> resources and royalty enforcement is structural rather than aspirational. The only code path that can simultaneously move an artwork and accept INIT lives inside provenance::royalty::settle, gated by Move's friend visibility. Free transfers (gifts) are explicitly allowed and emit GiftEvent. The result: a marketplace where royalty-skipping is unconstructable, not just discouraged.

honest_caveats: v0.1.0 is hackathon software. Six conditions remain between this and a production release; they are listed at /status on the live app and in docs/CUSTOMER_BUYER_REVIEW.md.
Image bytes live on R2 only; an IPFS mirror is committed for v1.1. The on-chain content_hash means any party with a copy can rehost.
Move modules are not externally audited. Single-builder team. Tomas (notional auditor persona) reviewed; no external sign-off.
Single sequencer, single challenger. Decentralisation is a v1.x roadmap item.
No wash-trade detection. Acknowledged in customer-buyer review.
